rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] challenged [RECIPIENT_nameDef] to a friendly spar, Pokémon against Pokémon, out in the yard, moves pulled and nobody hurt.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] let their Pokémon spar in the yard while half the colony leaned on the fence and called out advice.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] set their Pokémon to a gentle practice bout, three exchanges each, and argued about it all through supper.
r_logentry->[RECIPIENT_nameDef] said [RECIPIENT_possessive] Pokémon was the quicker, and [INITIATOR_nameDef] said there was one way to find out.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] whether [RECIPIENT_possessive] Pokémon could do a move, and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] had it show off a little.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] wanted to know from [RECIPIENT_nameDef] what it's like inside a Poké Ball. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] admitted [RECIPIENT_pronoun] didn't know either.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how to become a trainer, and got a long answer about patience that wasn't the one [INITIATOR_pronoun] wanted.
sent->[INITIATOR_nameDef]'s Pokémon came out on top, and both of them strutted about it all afternoon.
